{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders, refunded orders, and non-targeted channels
df_clean = df[
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search']))
]

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel to assess imbalance
# This is critical: if paid_search is also targeting loyal/returning customers, the comparison is confounded.

df_segment_channel = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])

df_segment_channel"}
